item.title: Fly tip on Roydene road now much bigger and covered in flies, 2nd August
item.description:
This fly tip on the corner of Roydene and Sladedale Roads was started by the council dumping bags there weeks ago, and added to by other flytippers. It has been reported several times, but the council’s only response was to add more bags to it. It is now huge and covered in flies. Please remove asap. I shall be sending these photos to my three ward councillors to ask for a explanation of why Greenwich is actively encouraging fly tipping on our road

item.title: Previously Reported Hawthorn hedge cuttings blocking pavement, 2nd August
item.description:
This has previously been reported, but nothing has been done about it. The cutting have 2cm thorns that can pierce soles of shoes and stab feet. Also they will puncture pneumatic tyres, such as those by mobility scooter users etc. There are no drop down kerbs on the south side of Cannon Road, which means that a mobility scooter user would have problems passing the obstruction. Even if they could get into the road, they would not be able to get back on to the safety of the pavement again. To pass the obstruction means walking in the road, which would probably also mean walking on the outside of cars in the middle of the road, which is not safe, especially for people with children.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Hudson Road, Upper Belvedere, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
